name: Steel Hellkite

Flying
{2}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
{X}: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X whose controller was dealt combat damage by this creature this turn. Activate only once each turn.
blocked_sentences: {X}: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X whose controller was dealt combat damage by this creature this turn. Activate only once each turn.

needs.what: a player spec (usable as a selector's `controller`, or as `for_each_player.players`) meaning 'each player dealt combat damage by this creature this turn', backed by a per-turn ledger of which players each source object dealt combat damage to
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The selector key `damaged_by` and trigger filter `damaged_by` read `state.damage_ledger`, which records damage to OBJECTS only; the condition `combat_damage_by` is prowl's table-wide 'a player was dealt combat damage by a <subtype>' and names neither the player nor the source object; `select_players` has no spec for damaged players. Emulating it with an unprinted `deals_combat_damage_to_player` trigger that sets a flag would add an ability the card does not print. The rest of the line ({X} cost via `x_value`, `mana_value` X, `not_types: [Land]`, `once_each_turn`) and the {2} pump line are expressible.
